text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Preparations for next olive oil crop and cereals season discussed at cabinet meeting chaired by President Ben Ali.
- Mohamed Daouas named as deputy to the Central Bank Governor, replacing Abdelmoumen Souayah.
- Prime Minister Hamed Karoui inaugurated Tunis Trade Fair which is to last until October 27.
- President Ben Ali met farmers and called for further efforts to make Tunisia's agriculture more competitive.
